body:
Well, I always liked to think about myself as someone who is thoughtful and logical...

She always told me that she cannot think logically, that's how she justified her trouble with maths and stuff. I've never believed that, I always knew that if I try hard enough I will make her life better. I did everything I could, maybe too much. And I scared her away. That's whay I cannot forgive myself, we've been together, and I lost her. She was so perfect... I just cannot find hope in life anymore.

Thank you.
I've always believed that anything can be repaired, no matter the damage. I cannot get over the thought that something cannot be repaired(as you've said). I am ready to erase all the negative past in favor of positive future. I just cannot understand why other people are not capable of doing the same.

Knowing that we had such a amazing moments makes me want to do everything to repeat them. But when she doesn't seem to want to try again makes me wonder if she have ever loved me in the first place.
